 Mr. B. P. Mishra, Advocate for the Informant
 Mr. B. K. Behera, Advocate for the Victim
 Coram: Justice Sibo Sankar Mishra

Order 
07.10.2024 Order No.

The petitioner is an accused in connection with Banpur P.S. Case No.121 of 2024 corresponding to G.R. Case no.179 of 2024 for the offences under Sections 376(2)(1)/294/506 of I.P.C. pending in the Court of the learned Assistant Sessions Judge, Banpur.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner, on instruction from the petitioner, submits that, except the present bail application, no other bail application of the petitioner is pending in any other Court relating to the aforesaid F.I.R.
3.

The allegation against the petitioner is that, on 13.03.2024, four months back prior to the incident at about 7.00 P.M., when the informant's daughter had been to a field to attend the call of nature, at that time, the accused-petitioner came to the spot and forcibly took her to a field and committed rape on her.
When the informant searched her daughter with the help of a torch light, he found that the present petitioner was alleged committing the act on her daughter.
It is also alleged that the petitioner threatened the informant along with her daughter not to disclose the incident before anybody else.
After some days, when the informant knew about the four months pregnancy of his daughter, on being asked about the same, thereafter, he lodged the F.I.R. against the petitioner.
4. The statement of the informant, who is the father of the victim was recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
He has made specific allegation against the petitioner.
It has come on record that the victim is 60% disabled girl and she was pregnant by the petitioner.

sentences.text: When the matter was heard before this Court on 05.09.2024, learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the parties have settled their dispute.

Even the informant being present in the Court,
has filed an affidavit through his counsel.
On behalf of the victim also, an affidavit has been filed through another counsel.
In the affidavit, both the victim as well as the informant has stated that they have settled their dispute with the petitioner on the intervention of the well-wishers and village gentries.
However, nothing is stated in the affidavit as to why the F.I.R. was registered and what is the present status of the victim girl.

6. Regard being had to the aforementioned, the I.I.C. Banpur P.S. is directed to verify the veracity of the affidavit submitted before this Court and file a report regarding the wellbeing and health condition of the victim on the next date of hearing.
7. List this matter on 23.10.2024.

(S.S. Mishra) Judge Swarna Location: High Court of Orissa Kalu Samantray vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party(S) on 7 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103332775/
